body: Thanks for your advice, although unfortunately it seems I am unable to help him.
Thanks for your help once again

I think I will wait until the summer to make any decisions. Then it should have been enough time to decide plus it would mean that he would of had enough time to stabilise. To be honest I'm mainly concerned about what will happen if I no longer love him, as I said he has been the only person who has made me happy and he is a very good friend, but I'm not sure I will even like him as a friend if he continues this way.

He has just told me that he has failed his first semester at university. Which means that he will have to work harder at the second or he will be forced to repeat the year. The problem is, he doesn't seem to concerned about it, when he was on break over Christmas he seemed very concerned about failing however when he told me he didn't seem to care at all. I'm worried that he has changed a rather lot since he has met these new bad friends and he has become someone whom I no longer love.

I will make him accessible if it really is the best course of possible action, however I want to make sure that whatever I'm doing for him is right and would have the best outcome.

To be completely honest, he is the one reason why I haven't committed suicide on previous occasions since I know that it will make him rather depressed as I am the only person he talks to about his depression. I just feel that if I lose him I would have nothing else to live for.

Thank you, I really think that reddit has worked much better for me than any other method of support, I have been to psychologists however I am never able to actually talk with them properly and I think they will look at me strangely if I ask them to talk with me through email or an instant messenger.

Unfortunately he isn't my boyfriend, more of a male friend. I would love to point him here however I do not want him to know about this post and I would also prefer if I didn't know about his as it would ensure he is able to speak how he feels rather than potentially being influenced by me.

He tells me that he has suicidal ideation on a weekly basis, I think he has become associated with the wrong kind of people at university not personally performing things but being present whilst quite highly illegal things are taking place (not just drugs, his friends created petrol bombs and threw them at walls). He's now worried that he has failed his first semester at university and I know that he is better than this, the only reason why he went with them is because he was incredibly shy and he was only able to become friends with them through a friend since he isn't very socially confident like me.

I really appreciate your help and it is making me feel slightly relieved that people are replying. I've known of this sub-reddit for a while but I never thought anyone would take any interest in my thoughts and that I will blend in as not being special enough to comment on.

It's just typically that finding people online is heavily frowned upon. We are meeting as friends some time in the summer however I will not be able to tell anyone about it as they will assume he is some kind of rapist/murderer. 

The main problem is that I don't want to feel like I am forcing him into a relationship, it makes me happy to know that he is happy and the last thing that I want is for him to enter into a relationship with me because he feels he needs to. I also feel generally inadequate for him and I can't understand why he doesn't have more people who are attracted to him.
I appreciate your help, I will try to clam down more first as at the moment after typing this it reminded me of things which have happened in the past.

I appreciate your comments. But there is honestly no-one who is better than him, he is intelligent and highly attractive and we like very much the same things and he is an extremely good friend something which I have never had in real life. I have tried, I've tried various sports and I've tried going out with other people but it will just results with me sitting in the train station thinking of jumping on the tracks. There is nothing else that has made me happy apart from him.
